question: For the comparison window, may production mctl-support traffic be routed through the gateway temporarily (needs a mctl-support release that sends cf-aig-authorization, plus a short NEBIUS_BASE_URL switch), or must the spike stay off-production and compare a synthetic harness against the gateway while calibrating the agent's own ledger against the Nebius console separately?
reason: The issue asks for gateway analytics compared against the agent's own spend counters for the same window, but also says nothing changes in production values until the report is accepted; mctl-support 0.3.6 only sends an Authorization header, so its counters cannot see gateway traffic without both a code change and a values change. The proposal proceeds with the off-production harness.

options: Off-production harness only; direct gateway-vs-ledger comparison happens after the go PR
Allow a bounded production window through the gateway after the mctl-support header change ships
